messages:
elena: FYI ticket from VectorLabs — they want streaming chat responses that can emit structured JSON records (for analytics pipeline) while also supporting function/tool calls. They want partial "events" as the model generates so their UI can render progress. They included a sample schema and webhook flow.

elena: TL;DR they need: 1) token-level stream + function-call metadata, 2) structured JSON frames that can be parsed incrementally, 3) ability to cancel and receive a final summary event.

elena: sample payload they sent:```json
{
  "event_type": "partial_record",
  "sequence": 12,
  "payload": { "user_intent": "extract_entities", "entities": [ {"type":"email","value":"a@x.com"} ] }
}```

ajay: This is deal-relevant for VectorLabs (SAML + Dedicated). They said shipping this capability influences their commit. Can we get an ETA? :eyes:

kevin: Need more clarity before we promise. Questions: which parts must be streamed vs can be batched? Do they need strict JSON schema validation server-side or just well-formed frames? Which models are they planning to use (big-llama-like quantized vs hosted high-capacity)?

elena: They asked for stream-first UX. Schema validation server-side preferred but they said client-side ok as fallback. Models: they currently plan to use our hosted Llama-variant, but would consider Dedicated.

sarah: Quick tech + tradeoffs: we already support streaming tokens + function-call metadata. Missing: a) framed structured output stream (atomic JSON frame boundaries), b) server-side schema validation and rejiggering of partial frames, c) consistent cancellation semantics that guarantee a final event.

sarah: Blockers: our streaming framing assumes free-text until completion. To support JSON frames we need framing tokens or an event protocol (e.g., newline-delimited frames with `event:` prefix) and careful buf/kv-cache handling. Also need to ensure fallback to non-streaming for older models.

sarah: Proposals (scope options):
- Minimal (P0-short): stream token + function-call metadata, include an envelope event when a JSON payload completes. No server-side schema validation. Client must stitch tokens -> parse. Est: 2 sprints (engineering + 1 qa).
- Full (P1): event stream with explicit JSON frames, server-side lightweight schema validation and error events, cancel semantics, replay for partial failed frames. Est: 4-6 sprints.

kevin: Thanks. For prioritization: Ajay, how critical for the ACV? If it's a contract requirement we can accelerate.

ajay: VectorLabs indicated it moves the needle on a six-figure ARR deal. If we can commit to a 6-8 week delivery (minimal) they will finalize legal. If we need >12 weeks they will ask for a roadmap milestone.

kevin: Proposed acceptance criteria for Minimal (to add to backlog):
- client can receive token stream and detect `function_call` metadata events
- when a structured response is produced, the stream emits a `structured_complete` envelope with the full JSON payload as one event
- cancellation API returns `canceled` event and a final partial summary
- compatibility tests pass on hosted models and Dedicated fallback
- perf: no >20% p99 latency regression under current streaming workloads

kevin: Proposed acceptance criteria for Full:
- streaming emits newline-delimited JSON frames with `event_type` field
- server validates against provided schema and emits `schema_error` events with diagnostics
- ability to re-request missing frames and server-side replay if model resumed
- e2e tests + UI integration smoke test + docs + migration guide

elena: Adding customer-provided test cases to the ticket would help. I'll ask them to attach small sample transcripts and the exact schema they expect.

sarah: I'll sketch a tech spec PR: include proposed event envelope (example below), framing rules, and API semantics (cancel/ack). Example event:```json
{
  "event_type": "partial_record",
  "seq": 5,
  "body": {
    "type": "entity",
    "data": {"email": "a@x.com"}
  }
}```

kevin: Can you also include backwards compatibility notes and a suggested rollout plan (canary on dedicated customers, opt-in flag)?

sarah: Yep. Suggest opt-in param `streaming_output_mode=frames|tokens` with default `tokens`. Canary on dedicated pool + 1 hosted region.

ajay: If we can commit to Minimal in 6-8 weeks, sales will push for the signed PO. Recommend we mark Minimal as P0 for VectorLabs with conditional timeline SLA.

kevin: OK — triage plan: create backlog ticket with Minimal scope + acceptance criteria, tag `sales-critical`, link to VectorLabs ticket. Owner: @sarah for tech spec PR, @elena to collect customer test vectors, @kevin to own rollout decision.

elena: I'll collect test cases today and update the ticket.

sarah: I'll open the tech spec draft by EOD and include an initial estimate.

ops-bot: deploy-notify: no active deploys affecting streaming runtime in the next 48h.

kevin: Thanks everyone. I'll add the triage ticket now and drop the link here.

kevin: https://redwood.internal/board/IN-4523 (backlog item created) :white_check_mark:
